title: DSP Bioprocess Scale-up Engineer
description:
Overview

Braskem, a global leader in the production of bio-based materials, is committed to reducing the carbon intensity of its products through development of technology utilizing bio-based feedstocks. In addition to its existing biotechnology research center in Campinas, Brazil, Braskem has recently opened a new renewable research and development facility in Lexington, MA. These two state-of-the-art facilities bring together scientists and engineers from a variety of disciplines to ideate and develop novel technologies for the production of bio-based chemicals and materials.

Braskem Innovation and Technology is seeking an exceptional downstream bioprocess engineer for conceptual process design and scale-up of emerging technologies in the area of bio-based chemicals via fermentation processes. The candidate will have primary responsibility for downstream commercial process design, ensuring technical risks are addressed and mitigated in the scale-up from lab to pilot/demo phases. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioprocess scale-up with experience in industrial implementation of new technology, technological knowledge of purification techniques for bio-processes, and comfort working closely with innovative teams from research and development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synthesize the conceptual process from broth clarification through product purification for fermentation-based technologies emerging from discovery teams in lab.
  • Work closely with the research team to guide experimental work with a view toward the commercial process design, and ensure relevant technical targets are set based on commercial process economics.
  • Guide in planning for the pilot plant testing program according to the conceptualized commercial design to ensure the key risks are mapped and mitigated as the technology progresses through scale-up.
  • Build strong relationships while working closely with the firms operating or constructing the pilot plant fermentation and downstream units.
  • Support process safety reviews for emerging technologies.
  • Generate the technology transfer package for the DSP section of the bioprocess. Serve as the DSP process expert during pilot and demo testing, being present onsite for extended periods.
  • Own responsibility as the expert on the process technology and key deliverables of the Process Design Package (PDP) that will be the basis for commercial design and engineering or toll manufacturing.

Additional Responsibilities and Activities

  • Identify and evaluate innovative and disruptive technologies through interaction with technology licensors, participation in events associated with bio-based chemical technologies, and review of international publications.
  • Carry out techno-economic assessments, actively participating in the preparation and/or technical review of mass and energy balances, PFD's, Capex and Opex estimates, among others.
  • Work with different teams within Braskem (e.g., process engineering, biotech and catalysis, sustainability, innovation, intellectual property, etc.) to guarantee the successful development of projects.
  • Collaborate with universities, start-ups and technology hubs seeking new technologies that may be of interest to Braskem.

Requirements

  • B.S. in Chemical Engineering or relevant field (Ph.D. is a plus) with a strong background in new technology development
  • 10+ years (including graduate research) experience in bioprocess engineering
  • Demonstrated experience in process development for fermentation product purification and implementation of new bioprocess technology at industrial scale.
  • Demonstrated expertise using process simulation software (SuperPro and/or Aspen Plus and Aspen Economic Analyzer)
  • Experience in pilot plant and/or demo plant operation
  • Experience with both solvent-based and aqueous-based recovery processes is a plus
  • Strong technical judgement to assess project decisions and timetables
  • Ability and seniority to ensure good interpersonal relationships and people management, to work on projects with internal and external interfaces
  • Have a working knowledge of intellectual property.
  • English and Portuguese fluency is required
  • Candidate will work in a hybrid mode with a home site of Campinas, Brazil to ensure a close working relationship with research teams at the Braskem Tech Centers.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Data Engineering Manager
description:
About QuintoAndar:

QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we simplify and reduce the bureaucracy of the experience of those looking for a new home. Thus, we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

The first steps in the international market have been taken since we acquired Grupo Navent, which is ranked number 1 in Mexico (Inmuebles24), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. And most recently, we launched Benvi, our international brand in Mexico, which comes with our residential rental product and service.

We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unlock a transaction. Think of zero paper or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside incredible human support.

We are currently valued at over $5.1 billion (August 2021) and continue to grow 4x year over year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration and high performance.

To learn more about our history, visit .

About Grupo QuintoAndar:

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diverse portfolio of brands and solutions that cover all stages of the journey of living. We develop technologies and innovations that transform and leverage the whole living experience.

About working at QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of learning;
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools in the market;
  • Work in an informal environment with a horizontal structure;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo and Campinas or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Language

This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application
  • Interview with Recruiter
  • Tech Screening
  • Interviews with Data Team
  • Leadership & Management
  • Offer

About the Position:
The primary goal for this position is to understand the company's data-related needs and develop a high-performance, self-service CDP (Customer Data Platform) with robust pipelines. This includes ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, security, data quality, profiling, documentation, lineage, and more.

Responsibilities of a Data Engineering Manager at QuintoAndar:

  • Be a technical reference for your team;
  • Overseeing the development and implementation of data pipelines and platform solutions, ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability;
  • Be willing to be hands-on, when needed;
  • Discuss business and engineering requirements with analysts, engineers and stakeholders on a deep level and anticipate risks;
  • Build a great team both recruiting great talent and helping them grow;
  • Evaluating the performance of team members, providing regular feedback, and identifying opportunities for their development;
  • Setting clear goals and objectives for the team and ensuring they are aligned with the overall business objectives;
  • Communicating effectively with stakeholders at various levels of the organization to understand their requirements or explain technical concepts;
  • Advocating for the value of data analytics and engineering within the organization and fostering a data-driven culture.

What we are looking for:

  • Recognizes that people are the most important asset and has extensive experience in people and careers management within the data career field.
  • A very technical manager that can discuss data event-driven architecture, in a modern stack paradigm;
  • Someone with background in both Data Platform and Data Pipelines;
  • Expert in dimensional data modeling (star schema or snowflake), with knowledge of technical concepts and best implementation practices;
  • Proficient in SQL and Python, passionate about writing clean, performant, and maintainable code;
  • Understands the data lifecycle and concepts such as architecture, lineage, governance, privacy, etc.;
  • Fluent in cloud infrastructure, such as AWS and GCP;
  • Experienced in designing and implementing event-driven architectures;
  • Keeps up with the evolution of technologies and best practices in the data engineering domain and seeks to apply them in the team's routine;
  • Someone with good communication skills, to collaborate with multiple stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Design, Data and Ops team)
  • Able to deal with uncertainty;
  • Able to define the strategic roadmap connecting with the business priorities and evolving the tech capabilities as setting the right expectations with the stakeholders;
  • Fluency in English is mandatory for this position.

Important:

  • Our selection process starts with the application! If you are truly interested in joining our team, make sure to put in extra effort at this stage. We review all candidates individually and provide feedback even to those who do not proceed in the process;
  • All communication is done via email, so be attentive to our messages and whitelist the @quintoandar.com.br domain to prevent our emails from going to spam.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

We’re looking for a highly driven and tech-savvy Technical Project Manager to join the Professional Services LATAM team at BEES. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful delivery and operational execution of ABI Markets and our Marketplace partners across LATAM. You’ll lead the activation and rollout of strategic products within our ecosystem — including BEES Customer, BEES Care, BEES Grow, BEES Force, BEES One, BEES Link, BEES Deliver, and BEES Now — ensuring seamless integration, feature activation, and partner expansion.

Overview

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente para nossa nova loja do Shopping Iguatemi Campinas , que acredite que é possível encantar e criar relações duradouras com nossas equipes e clientes.

Buscamos profissionais que queiram atuar em um novo modelo de relacionamento com o varejo, que ao invés de pensar somente na venda pela venda, acreditem que é possível redesenhar as relações de trabalho entre pessoas e empresas.

  • Gerenciar o inventário de loja para mantê-la sempre abastecida;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores de lentes e outros terceiros e orientar equipe no cumprimento dos prazos de montagens de óculos e de consertos;
  • Seguir as metas e os indicadores de desempenho que valorizem o profissional completo, com avaliações mensais de cada colaborador, indicando o caminho para o desenvolvimento e crescimento na marca.

Qualificações

  • Vasto conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho comercial;
  • Experiência anterior em cargo de gestão com bastante foco em desenvolvimento de equipes;
  • Experiência em gestão no ramo óptico é um diferencial!

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Electrical Engineer role at Soben .

Department: Brazil Consultancy | Location: Campinas, Brazil

Job Description

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning process of data centers, ensuring that all electrical systems are installed, tested, and operational according to project specifications and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commissioning Planning and Execution:
    • Develop and review commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules.
    • Conduct inspections, tests, and validations of electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, and emergency systems.
    • Document and report findings, issues, and resolutions.
    • Monitor RFIs (Request for Information).
  • Coordination and Communication:
    • Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure compliance with project requirements.
    • Provide technical support and guidance to team members and stakeholders.
    • Participate in project meetings and provide updates on commissioning progress.
  • Quality Assurance and Control:
    • Ensure all commissioning activities comply with industry standards and client requirements.
    • Identify and resolve issues during the commissioning process.
    • Conduct quality audits and witness necessary site tests.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation plans.
    • Monitor and report on the status of risk mitigation efforts.
  • Documentation and Reporting:
    • Prepare and maintain commissioning documentation and reports, including Commissioning and Sequence of Energization Plans.
    • Ensure all necessary documentation is completed and approved.
    • Technical Analysis: executive design, inspection plans, commissioning reports (FATs, FWTs and site tests), technical specifications, submittals and test scripts.
  • Schedule:
    • Executive schedule monitoring.
    • Deliveries monitoring.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

Preferred Qualifications / Relevant Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably with a focus on data center projects.
  • Experience in LV/MV electrical equipment and systems commissioning processes and procedures is mandatory and highly desirable.
  • Experience in data center LV/MV electrical equipment and systems commissioning processes and procedures is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus (Brazilian Standards: NR10 Basic + SEP).
  • Certifications in commissioning, and MBA are a plus.
  • Organized and detail-oriented.

Você ajudará a garantir que nossos clientes sejam cobrados no momento certo, sem duplicidade, com rastreabilidade de ponta a ponta e resiliência frente a falhas de sistemas parceiros.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter serviços backend que suportam ciclos de arrecadação, débito em conta, boletos, PIX e integrações com bancos/conveniados.
  • Implementar e sustentar lógicas de bloqueio/desbloqueio, reprocessos, exceções de cobrança e reconciliação de dados.
  • Construir APIs e fluxos assíncronos (mensageria) com foco em alta disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas.
  • Monitorar saúde das aplicações (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing) e atuar em incidentes de produção.
  • Trabalhar próximo(a) a áreas de Produto, Arquitetura, Dados, SRE e Negócios para traduzir regras financeiras complexas em software confiável.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões técnicos e melhoria contínua do ecossistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sênior em backend com Java ou Kotlin (aceitamos forte base em outra stack + disposição para migrar).
  • Vivência com microsserviços e APIs REST em produção.
  • Uso de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou equivalente) para fluxos assíncronos.
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server etc.), incluindo modelagem e tuning.
  • Experiência em integrações financeiras (ex: CNAB, APIs bancárias, cobrança/consignado, boletos ou arrecadação).
  • Testes automatizados (unitários + integração) e uso de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes Linux/containers (Docker, Kubernetes ou similar).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com processos de consignado ou arrecadação multibanco.
  • Manipulação de grandes volumes de transações e controles de idempotência.
  • Padrões de resiliência: retry, backoff, circuit breaker, dead-letter, compensações.
  • Observabilidade avançada (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic, Splunk).
  • Experiência em sistemas regulados (bancário, pagamentos, fintechs).
  • Exposição a data lakes / pipelines de conciliação / batch crítico.
  • Conhecimento de segurança aplicada a integrações financeiras (certificados, mTLS, segregação de credenciais, auditoria).

Benefícios

  • Vale refeição
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale transporte

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Senior Software Engineer (Women Applicants Only)
description:
About QuintoAndar
QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we simplify and reduce the bureaucracy of the experience of those looking for a new home. Thus, we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

The first steps in the international market have been taken since we acquired Grupo Navent, which is ranked number 1 in Mexico (Inmuebles24), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. And most recently, we launched Benvi, our international brand in Mexico, which comes with our residential rental product and service.

We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unlock a transaction. Think of zero paper or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside incredible human support.

We are currently valued at over $5.1 billion (August 2021) and continue to grow 4x year over year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration and high performance.

To learn more about our history, visit .

About Grupo QuintoAndar:

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diverse portfolio of brands and solutions that cover all stages of the journey of living. We develop technologies and innovations that transform and leverage the whole living experience.

About working at QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of learning;
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools in the market;
  • Work in an informal environment with a horizontal structure;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo and Campinas or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Language

This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application
  • Tech Screening
  • Technicals Interviews with Engineering Team
  • Phone interview with Recruiters
  • Offer

About the Area:

These are the Senior Software Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent (micro-)services that address specific solutions;
  • Responsible for the entire lifecycle of their code;
  • Contribute not only with your immediate team’s challenges but with the whole procut team team - by sharing inputs/code/etc;
  • Improve the development experience at QuintoAndar by enhancing development tools, test coverage, and/or code structure;
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions of software design. Building and helping to create documentations;
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user driven solutions. We use several different technologies: from Java over SQL databases, to Polymer over MongoDB. We also have micro-services written in Java, Python, Node or Clojure, gorgeous PWA experiences in React, complex data flows in Datomic . You don't need to know all these upfront, but we will give you space to learn and improve;
  • Help organize software architecture to harmonically orchestrate our services architecture.

Seniority Level:

We want to have as many talented people as possible in our team. So, although this position is described as “Senior Software Engineer”, you can apply even if you don’t consider yourself as a senior professional yet. It’s important to us to create a qualified talent poll and we will definitely reach out to you if we think you can add to our teams, no matter what seniority level you are today.

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and relational databases;
  • Experience using RESTful APIs;
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software, valuing work-life balance;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and knowledge in English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries;
  • Excellent english skills (verbal and written) is mandatory.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Know computer theory, including optimization of algorithms and distributed systems;
  • Already developed scalable client-server mobile applications;
  • Have experience with cloud service platforms and its services (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc);
  • Understand how modern CD/CI works;
  • Have some knowledge on containers and container-orchestration (eg. Kubernetes);
  • Know how to test and tune scalability;
  • Understand the work is never done; we are always taking care and evolving our services.

Important:

  • Our selection process starts with the application! If you are truly interested in joining our team, make sure to put in extra effort at this stage. We review all candidates individually and provide feedback even to those who do not proceed in the process;
  • All communication is done via email, so be attentive to our messages and whitelist the @quintoandar.com.br domain to prevent our emails from going to spam.

  • Health plan;
  • Dental plan (optional);
  • Life insurance;
  • Daycare subsidy;
  • Subsidy to sports practicing (Gympass).
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave;
  • Reserved room for breast-feeding*;
  • Discount on our parking lot;*
  • Educational discounts;
  • Free transfer from Vila Madalena and Fradique Coutinho stations to the office*;
  • Free bike rack in our parking lot.*

Diversity & Inclusion at QuintoAndar

At QuintoAndar, we believe diversity of perspectives and experiences guarantee a differentiated work environment, based on respect and valuing differences. Feel free to declare the information on the registration form. If you are not comfortable answering them, just choose the option "I prefer not to respond". This information helps us create an increasingly inclusive environment and it is used only for this purpose, it is confidential, and it will not impact your performance throughout the hiring process

description:
Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657

Join to apply for the Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657 role at AgileEngine.

Overview

As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.

What you will do

description:
About QuintoAndar
QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we simplify and reduce the bureaucracy of the experience of those looking for a new home. Thus, we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

The first steps in the international market have been taken since we acquired Grupo Navent, which is ranked number 1 in Mexico (Inmuebles24), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. And most recently, we launched Benvi, our international brand in Mexico, which comes with our residential rental product and service.

We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unlock a transaction. Think of zero paper or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside incredible human support.

We are currently valued at over $5.1 billion (August 2021) and continue to grow 4x year over year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration and high performance.

To learn more about our history, visit .

About Grupo QuintoAndar:

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diverse portfolio of brands and solutions that cover all stages of the journey of living. We develop technologies and innovations that transform and leverage the whole living experience.

About working at QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of learning;
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools in the market;
  • Work in an informal environment with a horizontal structure;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo and Campinas or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Language

This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application
  • Phone interview with Recruiters
  • Tech Screening
  • Technicals Interviews with Engineering Team
  • Offer

About the Area:

These are the Senior Software Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent (micro-)services that address specific solutions;
  • Responsible for the entire lifecycle of their code;
  • Contribute not only with your immediate team’s challenges but with the whole procut team team - by sharing inputs/code/etc;
  • Improve the development experience at QuintoAndar by enhancing development tools, test coverage, and/or code structure;
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions of software design. Building and helping to create documentations;
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user driven solutions. We use several different technologies: from Java over SQL databases, to Polymer over MongoDB. We also have micro-services written in Java, Python, Node or Clojure, gorgeous PWA experiences in React, complex data flows in Datomic . You don't need to know all these upfront, but we will give you space to learn and improve;
  • Help organize software architecture to harmonically orchestrate our services architecture.

Seniority Level:

We want to have as many talented people as possible in our team. So, although this position is described as “Senior Software Engineer”, you can apply even if you don’t consider yourself as a senior professional yet. It’s important to us to create a qualified talent poll and we will definitely reach out to you if we think you can add to our teams, no matter what seniority level you are today.

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language and relational databases;
  • Experience using RESTful APIs;
  • People that are seeking to learn and deliver real impact through high-quality data-driven and structured software, valuing work-life balance;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and knowledge in English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries;

You'll stand out if you:

Important:

About AB InBev

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you'll do

  • Design, model, and maintain end-to-end BI solutions in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX calculations, report building, and interactive dashboards that drive business decision-making.
  • Use SQL and Python to query, clean, and analyze large datasets, ensuring accuracy and reliability of the data used in reporting.
  • Transform analytical findings into compelling narratives that connect data insights with business strategies for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Apply best practices in data visualization and user-centric design to deliver impactful, intuitive, and actionable dashboards and reports.

What you'll need

  • BA/BS/MS in Math, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other related quantitative field.
  • Advanced knowledge of Power BI (data modeling, DAX, report building, and dashboard design).
  • Advanced expertise in SQL for querying and data preparation.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written) to effectively communicate insights with international stakeholders.
  • Experience with Python for statistical analysis
  • Strong skills in data storytelling : ability to craft clear narratives that connect data insights to business strategy, ensuring stakeholders easily understand and act on the information.
  • Deep understanding of data visualization best practices, design principles, and user-centric dashboards.
  • Ability to translate complex datasets into insightful, visually compelling, and actionable reports.
  • Organized and detail-oriented, capable of delivering under tight timelines while ensuring quality.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills , able to tailor the message for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills to work across cross-functional teams.

More about you

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Storytelling mindset, connecting data insights to business impact in a compelling way.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented attitude, anticipating needs and suggesting improvements.
  • Collaborative approach, working effectively with cross-functional and international teams while building trust and alignment.
  • Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and high-quality standards in all deliverables.
  • Adaptable and resilient, comfortable managing tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Strategic thinking, always connecting insights to business outcomes and long-term goals.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Overview


Join to apply for the Principal Product Manager role at AB InBev .


AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.


About AB InBev Growth Group


Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world


.In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.


We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.


About the Role


We’re seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Principal Product Manager to shape the future of our sales systems and tools. In this highly autonomous, individual contributor role, you’ll lead initiatives that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of our frontline sales teams including field, administrative, and tele-sales functions.


You’ll take a step back to uncover foundational opportunities that drive long-term impact across the business. Your work will help unify sales workflows, elevate user experience, and influence how we scale and support sales organizations.


What You’ll Do



  • Develop deep expertise in how frontline sales teams operate by identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs through research and partnership.

  • Create and champion a strategic product vision that aligns user workflows, business goals, and emerging trends in sales operations.

  • Define mid- to long-term initiatives that improve productivity, scalability, and system usability.

  • Collaborate with partners in product, engineering, design, data, and sales operations to frame high-impact problems and explore solutions. Connect business strategy, user needs, and technical capabilities to influence product direction and priorities.

  • Advocate for changes across process, technology, and organizational practices that deliver meaningful impact.

  • Clearly articulate trade-offs and opportunities to senior stakeholders and help guide resource allocation across teams.


What We’re Looking For



  • Proven success leading strategic product initiatives in complex environments, ideally at the principal level or equivalent.

  • Ability to think holistically and long-term, with a focus on solving systemic issues over incremental improvements.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful insights, and use metrics to drive strategic decision.

  • Experience working in or closely with field sales, tele-sales, or sales operations organizations

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders at all levels.

  • Strong product intuition, user empathy, and a systems-thinking mindset.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and thriving in a role with high autonomy and broad scope


Preferred Qualifications



  • Background in B2B sales systems, CRM platforms, or internal tools supporting sales teams.

  • Experience leading discovery and research in enterprise or cross-functional environments

  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, with the ability to collaborate closely with designers to deliver intuitive and effective sales tools.

  • Ability to evaluate technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams and make informed decisions that balance user needs, scalability, and complexity.

  • Advanced degree in business, operations, or a related field is a plus—especially if it supports strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and organizational change. Equivalent experience is equally valued.


More about you



  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.

  • You´re motivated by building world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world.

  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;

  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;

  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.


What We Offer

  • Attendance Bonus*

  • Casual office and dress code

  • Days off*

  • Health, dental, and life insurance

  • Discounts on Ambev products*

  • School materials assurance

  • Language and training platforms

  • Not Applicable

title: Sales Development Representative (NA)
description:
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) located in Brazil, you will play a critical role in supporting 4flow’s North America sales and marketing teams. Your role is to identify and engage potential customers in the US and Canada, generating high-quality leads and setting up meetings for our senior sales team, including Directors and VPs. You will collaborate closely with our global marketing team, US-based Account Executives, and Sales Managers to ensure a seamless lead handoff and help drive the expansion of 4flow’s consulting, supply chain software, and managed transportation solutions across North America.

What Your New Challenge Will Look Like

  • Prospect and qualify potential customers in the US and North American market using platforms like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and tools such as Outreach, Reev, Meetime, Snov.io, HubSpot, and Salesforce HVS.
  • Engage decision-makers (Director/C-level) via email, LinkedIn messaging, and cold calling to introduce 4flow’s supply chain services and software solutions.
  • Schedule qualified meetings for 4flow Directors and VPs—this is your primary KPI.
  • Conduct account-based research to support targeted campaigns, understand company priorities, and map key stakeholders across supply chain, logistics, and IT functions.
  • Collaborate with marketing to optimize lead generation strategies and nurture prospective client relationships.
  • Maintain detailed records of outreach activities, lead interactions, and pipeline status in CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot.
  • Support sales activities across multiple industries, including automotive, consumer goods, retail, and industrial sectors.

Why you belong at 4flow

  • You have a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Relations, or a related field.
  • Previous SDR experience is required, preferably in B2B SaaS, consulting, or supply chain/logistics industries.
  • You have advanced English skills. Both written and spoken, to confidently interact with US-based executives.
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing lead pipelines and CRM systems.
  • You thrive on making connections and enjoy reaching out to Managers, Directors, and C-level contacts.
  • You have strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint for tracking KPIs and supporting sales initiatives.
  • You’re motivated by growth and eager to contribute to 4flow’s expansion in the US market from Brazil.

What We Offer

4flow offers a clearly defined vision, excellent job security, and outstanding opportunities for your individual development. As part of a highly international, fast-growing company with a vibrant corporate culture, you will enjoy a competitive base salary, an attractive bonus system, and a great benefits package.

Ready for 4flow? Then please apply online. Please upload an English version of your resume when applying.

Job details

  • Seniority level: Associate
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Sales and Business Development
  • Industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
Overview

A EY é líder global em serviços de Auditoria, Impostos, Transações Corporativas e Consultoria. Desenvolvemos líderes de excelência com ética e qualidade, contribuindo para gerar confiança no mercado de capitais e em economias ao redor do mundo. Contamos com quase 35.000 profissionais atendendo a indústria financeira globalmente, incluindo bancos, seguradoras e gestoras de patrimônio. No Brasil, atuamos junto aos principais centros mundiais para compartilhar conhecimento sobre tendências e regulamentações atuais, ajudando nossos clientes a resolver questões em gestão de riscos, controles internos, estratégia, operações e tecnologia da informação.

Este grupo de profissionais busca, neste momento, o candidato certo para integrar o time, desenvolver uma carreira sólida e ascendente, e contribuir para um mundo de negócios melhor para nossos colaboradores, clientes e comunidades.

Na EY, você terá liberdade, ferramentas e condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira única. Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO), apoiamos as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos clientes do segmento financeiro, oferecendo soluções sob medida a partir de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas com perfis variados, como especialistas em Dados, UX, analistas de negócios e scrum masters.

Seu papel

Como Cientista de Dados Pleno, você atuará em clientes de grande porte, com possibilidade de crescimento em frentes diversas na área de dados voltadas para o segmento financeiro. Contará com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar preparado para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, clientes e comunidades.

Você poderá atuar diretamente com tecnologias avançadas de IA Generativa e LLMs (como GPT, LLaMA e Mistral). O ambiente é inovador, com forte incentivo à pesquisa aplicada e experimentação em IA. Haverá oportunidade de participar do desenvolvimento de soluções reais e escaláveis, com cultura colaborativa e times multidisciplinares, e potencial de crescimento acelerado em projetos estratégicos de alto impacto.

Por que você?

Se você é apaixonado(a) por dados, colaboração e tem as seguintes qualificações, queremos você na nossa equipe:

  • Formação completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e/ou correlatas;
  • Ampla experiência em Python, especialmente para aplicações de IA; domínio de frameworks de LLMs (ex.: Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain, OpenAI API);
  • Proficiência com pipelines de dados, ETL, Apache NiFi, Apache Kafka; prática com versionamento de código (Git), testes automatizados e programação orientada a objetos;
  • Vivência com integração entre sistemas via APIs ou mensagens. Prompt engineering e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para leitura técnica e ferramentas.

Desejável – diferenciais:
- Experiência prática em projetos de IA/Data Science, preferencialmente em setor financeiro (bancos/seguradoras), tecnologia, consultorias ou startups;
- Atuação em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e participação em comunidades ou projetos open source de IA;
- Familiaridade com publicações, artigos ou apresentações em eventos de tecnologia;
- Experiência prévia com validação humana de modelos (human-in-the-loop);
- Certificações em Data Science (ex.: IBM Data Science, AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer) ou cursos reconhecidos em ML/IA/Big Data.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar na evolução de modelos baseados em LLMs, desde o prompt engineering até a implantação em produção;
  • Criar, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados utilizando ferramentas de mercado (NiFi, Kafka);
  • Automatizar processos de ETL e integração entre sistemas;
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento e testabilidade das soluções, atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.

Condições

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para remoto) nos escritórios da EY Brasil.

O que oferecemos

Vale alimentação, vale refeição, vale transporte, plano de saúde, assistência odontológica, universidade corporativa e outros benefícios, incluindo Educacionais, Gympass, PLR e muito mais. Conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, oferecemos experiências excepcionais com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento.

Acreditamos que a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Temos reconhecimento em programas de diversidade e equidade. Se você se sente desafiado(a), motivado(a) e valorizado(a) diariamente, venha fazer parte do nosso time e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Carreiras na EY | LinkedIn | Instagram

A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados são considerados.

  • Negociar prazos e alinhamentos entre as partes, garantindo que as entregas estejam dentro do esperado e respeitando as diretrizes estratégicas;
  • Apoiar a execução das estratégias de comunicação interna e externa, assegurando que as mensagens estejam alinhadas e sejam coerentes com o posicionamento da empresa;
  • Produzir, revisar, traduzir e adaptar conteúdos em português e mandarim para diversos canais, incluindo comunicados, releases, apresentações executivas e relatórios;
  • Desenvolver e apresentar relatórios com indicadores de desempenho e resultados das ações de comunicação;
  • Promover campanhas de engajamento e comunicação digital, alinhadas às melhores práticas e tendências do mercado;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Analista de Data Analytics Local Pl – Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno.

Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Analista de Data Analytics Local Pl – Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Empresa: CPFL Renováveis – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

Qualifications

  • Formação Superior Completo em Exatas: Engenharias, Estatística, Matemática, Física, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com ciência de dados;
  • Capacidade analítica e facilidade em modelar, interpretar e apresentar resultados;
  • Conhecimento em programação para análise de dados (Ex: Python, Spark);
  • Desejável conhecimento em construção de consultas em bancos de dados (Ex: SQL);
  • Desejável inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia

  • Executar análise avançada de dados (advanced analytics/ data science) utilizando conceitos de big data, para gerar insights para as áreas de negócio do grupo CPFL;
  • Avaliar, propor e implementar metodologias estatística, de inteligência artificial e machine learning, avaliando o contexto, prazo de entrega e dados disponíveis;
  • Liderar projetos de análise de dados com outras áreas para ganhos operacionais nas diversas unidades de negócio, construindo relacionamento com outras áreas, buscando oportunidades, subsídios para compreensão do escopo de trabalho e entendimento das regras envolvidas no negócio.
  • Trabalhar na aquisição e tratamento de dados de dados complexos, com foco em alta volumetria, criando códigos de extração replicáveis;
  • Realizar apresentações de nivelamento e resultados para todos os públicos da CPFL, incluindo reports aos executivos do grupo e redigir relatório de análise documentando os estudos realizados.
  • Acompanhar execução dos modelos em produção, geração de indicadores de desempenho e definição do momento em que os modelos precisam de atualização.

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias;
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços .

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia eléctrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso praticamos ações afirmativas em que reservamos vagas para aumentar cada vez mais a representatividade de grupos sociais minorizados, como por exemplo, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência e pessoas negras. Valorizamos a diversidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Overview

Analista de Desenvolvimento Tecnológico SR (Processamento de Nanocompósitos - )

Para atuar no grupo de Processamento de Nanocompósitos do Laboratório Nacional de Nanotecnologia (LNNANO). O laboratório de processamento de nanocompósitos poliméricos tem produzido nanocompósitos multifuncionais utilizando materiais renováveis como polissacarídeos (amido e celulose), látex de borracha natural e lignina, além de polímeros termoplásticos biodegradáveis. Rotas coloidais (água como solvente majoritário) e termoplásticas (polímeros fundidos) de processamento são aplicadas no desenvolvimento de nanocompósitos como adesivos, materiais altamente porosos e filmes para aplicação em embalagens.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Preparar formulações para revestimentos de barreira para papel usando materiais de fontes renováveis;
  • Refinar biomassas: polpação e produção de nanoestruturas de celulose e lignina;
  • Aplicar revestimentos em diferentes substratos celulósicos, assim como suas respectivas caracterizações: mecânicas, morfológicas e de propriedades de barreiras (como barreiras à água, oxigênio, óleos e vapores);
  • Preparar procedimentos experimentais, coletar e interpretar dados, relatórios e artigos científicos.

  • Experiência na área de revestimentos de barreira para papel;

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Sales manager role at Imerys .

The Company

The world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for industry with 14,000 employees, operations in more than 40 countries, and €4.3 billion in revenue in 2022. Imerys delivers high-value-added, functional solutions to a great number of sectors, from processing industries to consumer goods. The Group draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge and expertise in material science to deliver solutions by beneficiating its mineral resources, synthetic minerals and formulations. Imerys’ solutions contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance, including heat resistance, hardness, conductivity, opacity, durability, purity, lightness, filtration, absorption and water repellency. Imerys is determined to develop responsibly, in particular by fostering the emergence of environmentally-friendly products and processes.

Imerys delivers sustainability as a core value and aims to grow skills and careers across its global footprint.

Role Summary

On March 28, 2024, Imerys Group published a press release announcing exclusive negotiations with Flacks Group for the contemplated divestment of its assets producing kaolin, ground calcium carbonate (GCC), precipitated calcium carbonate (PCC), and talc, which primarily serve the paper markets in North America, South America, Asia and Europe. The future company formed by these industrial sites is expected to start operating under a new brand in 2024 and will offer mineral solutions for industries worldwide. The new company will use its global footprint, assets and know-how to develop opportunities and foster innovation. Sustainability is a core value of this company.

The activity has an annual revenue of around €350 million (2023) and about 1,000 employees. The Company needs to reinforce existing teams to operate as a standalone organization and to meet ambitious development plans.

Role Overview

Drive organic and inorganic growth for customers and prospects in the perimeter you are responsible for. Support business and market developments, working with Business Development, S&T and Marketing. Be responsible for the profitability of the activity on all the customers present in your perimeter.

Missions

  • Develop and execute the commercial roadmaps developed for your segment/products/perimeter
  • Execute price increases as per the pricing strategy
  • Account management (negotiating short-term and long-term contracts, identifying growth/profitability opportunities, and advancing relationships with customers to maximize market share)
  • Ensure business performance by servicing the existing customer base and developing new growth opportunities
  • Develop plans and strategies for developing new commercial opportunities and achieving sales goals, with strong internal and external relationship building
  • Establish and nurture relationships with customers at multi-level management (upper management, purchasing, R&D)
  • Analyze sales trends and prepare reports for management; advise on business

Responsibilities

The commitment of the employee goes beyond respecting rules and procedures. Each employee is responsible to identify and report unsafe situations to guarantee corrective actions. Employees should develop ideas to improve safety and have an active role in its implementation. The employee is responsible for their own safety and other team members. Safety is everyone’s commitment. They should use the correct PPE and follow EHS norms/protocols. The employee should be committed to sustainable actions, focusing on activities to lower environmental impact, acting with ethics, and respecting diversity and inclusion.

Knowledge And Skills

  • Strong leadership skills to find win-win solutions both internally and externally
  • Strong time management skills to balance a rigorous field work schedule

Degree in preferably Chemistry, or Chemical or Mechanical Engineering. Experience: minimum 5 years in a commercial role with strong exposure to complex customers. Fluent in English and Spanish.

Qualifications

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Computação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Habilidade avançada/fluente em comunicação em inglês.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Sobre nós - Grupo Revise O Grupo Revise atua há mais de 28 anos no setor automotivo brasileiro, destaca-se pela qualidade certificada e pelo pioneirismo. Como uma empresa 100% brasileira, possui 3 marcas: Brazzo, Mobato e Varimax, com 6 centros de distribuição estratégicos em todo o país e um amplo portfólio que inclui milhares de itens de alta qualidade em prol da satisfação dos clientes, reforçados pela certificação ISO 9001:2015.

SOBRE A MOBATO A Mobato é uma marca que oferece soluções digitais para conectar clientes ao setor automotivo, com adaptabilidade a diversas plataformas tecnológicas e integração a sistemas ERP's e DMS's. Suas soluções digitais visam transformar o atendimento de serviços em uma experiência rápida e eficiente, eliminando burocracias e proporcionando agilidade. Priorizando a satisfação do cliente, a Mobato busca compreender suas necessidades para garantir a prosperidade dos negócios. Vem ser MOBATO!

Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar e executar lançamentos de produtos e funcionalidades, alinhados às equipes de produto, vendas e marketing;
  • Definir mensagens-chave, diferenciais e posicionamento de mercado, considerando as necessidades de montadoras, concessionárias e proprietários de veículos;
  • Criar e implementar estratégias de precificação baseadas em análise de mercado e comportamento do cliente;
  • Desenvolver narrativas e mensagens que reforcem o valor dos produtos Mobato;
  • Criar materiais de apoio para vendas (apresentações, casos de uso, guias de produtos, FAQs);
  • Colaborar com a área de marketing para estruturar campanhas que destaquem os benefícios das soluções;
  • Conduzir workshops, pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrentes para identificar tendências e oportunidades;
  • Mapear necessidades dos clientes e definir personas em colaboração com as equipes de dados e produto;
  • Acompanhar a jornada do cliente para identificar pontos de melhoria na adoção e retenção;
  • Fornecer insights de mercado e materiais para capacitar a equipe de vendas;
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas com concessionárias e montadoras para coletar feedback;
  • Criar estratégias que maximizem retenção e geração de valor no ecossistema Mobato;
  • Definir e monitorar métricas de sucesso para lançamentos de produtos, campanhas e engajamento de clientes;
  • Realizar análises pós-lançamento para avaliar resultados e identificar melhorias contínuas.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência em planejamento e execução de estratégias Go-to-Market (GTM);
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas de mercado, workshops, análise de concorrentes e criação de personas;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Tableau, etc.);
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de materiais de apoio para vendas e campanhas de marketing;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Você se destaca se tiver

  • Conhecimento do mercado automotivo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA;
  • Espanhol;
  • Vivência em empresas SaaS ou tecnologia.

description:
Overview

Talent Expansion Analyst for ABI Growth Group – AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft. We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you'll do

  • Lead the planning, design, and execution of comprehensive test strategies (functional, non-functional, regression, integration, performance, security, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain detailed and efficient test plans, test cases, and automation scripts.
  • Implement and manage automated tests for APIs, web, and/or mobile applications.
  • Perform exploratory and risk-based manual testing when necessary.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other teams to understand requirements and ensure adequate test coverage.
  • Identify, document, and track defects clearly and concisely, working with development teams to resolve them.
  • Analyze test results, generate reports, and provide constructive feedback.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, methodologies, and tools.
  • Actively participate in agile ceremonies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in QA and test automation.

What you'll need

  • University degree in courses related to computing such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, and Systems Analysis and Development.
  • Intermediate English with a focus on understanding meetings and technical readings.
  • Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and principles.
  • Hands-on experience in building and maintaining test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright for web; Appium for mobile; Postman, Rest Assured for API).
  • Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Experience with test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Azure DevOps).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and how to integrate automated tests into the pipeline.
  • Analytical skills to identify failures, root causes, and propose solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with BDD/TDD methodologies.

Nice to have

  • Experience with performance testing (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Experience with testing in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

More about you

  • You’re proactive and takes initiative to solve problems before they escalate.
  • You’re adaptable and comfortable working in dynamic environments with changing priorities.
  • You collaborate effectively within large teams, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues.
  • You’re analytical and detail-oriented, capable of critically evaluating processes and results.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, ensuring alignment with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Application Security Engineer to serve as a trusted partner to our software development teams. This role focuses on making our product secure by design—embedding security into how software is architected, written, deployed, and maintained. Unlike infrastructure security roles, this position centers on application-layer and code-level security, working closely with developers to enable fast, confident delivery by providing meaningful, actionable security tooling and feedback. This includes leveraging modern AI-assisted techniques to accelerate vulnerability analysis, exploit chaining, and demonstration of actual risk. You will ensure engineering teams move faster—not slower—while minimizing noise. This role is part of the IT & Security team and prioritizes embedding guardrails into developer workflows rather than enforcement gates.

About Nerdy: At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we\'re redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale. We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you\'d bet on as solo founders - people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

  • AI-Native at every level From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you\'re not wielding AI, you\'re not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free-market rigor Ideas rise or fall on merit and results - no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
  • Full-stack ownership You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
  • Reward for contribution Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
  • Relentless exploration Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and - because only the paranoid survive - questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
  • Is Apolitical You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Experience as an Application Security Engineer, Security Consultant, or Security-focused Software Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability patterns.
  • Ability to apply common web application attack techniques and create proof-of-concept exploits to validate whether vulnerabilities are exploitable in our environment.
  • Proven ability to analyze exploit chains and demonstrate actual risk, leveraging AI to accelerate discovery and validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Ruby, Go, JavaScript/React, and related frameworks.

  • Ability to assess and communicate application risk in architectural and business context.
  • Comfortable demonstrating real-world exploits to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Vendedor(a) - Shopping Parque das Bandeiras

Descrição da vaga: Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ? Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes. Esta convocação é para você, que tem garra e paixão por vencer e quer assumir uma posição peça-chave do nosso time, afinal, a loja tem que estar organizada para o jogo acontecer.

Responsabilidades

  • Saber mostrar o que temos de melhor em calçados, de acordo com as necessidades e especificações de cada cliente, além de destacar as tecnologias disponíveis no mercado.
  • Dar aquele show de conhecimento para os nossos clientes, com muita energia e disposição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Experiência com vendas e/ou atendimento
  • Conhecimento em calçados é considerado um diferencial

Informações adicionais

SOBRE A CENTAURO
A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time joga Entrosado, afinal, aqui miramos o topo. Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso TimeDeCampeões!

SOBRE NÓS
Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF. Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil. Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência. Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor. Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito. Movimentar é o nosso esporte.

Somos uma empresa de materiais de construção e soluções sustentáveis com mais de 13 mil empregados. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.

title: Vendedor(a) Externo - Campinas
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Sobre a área de Sales

O time de vendas na Lemon tem papel relevante para que a gente alcance nossa missão de empoderar as empresas e pessoas para acelerarmos a transição rumo à energia sustentável. O principal foco do time é trazer o maior número de novos clientes e, para isso, buscamos pessoas que sejam protagonistas da sua própria entrega de resultado e que gostem de um ambiente acelerado e de muitas mudanças. Acreditamos que para cumprir nossa missão precisamos ter um time de altíssima performance, muito engajado no nosso propósito e com foco na qualidade das vendas feitas.

O field sales é um vendedor externo, isso que dizer que essa pessoa atua com visitas presenciais em nossos leads e clientes com foco em prospecção, apresentação e conversão de vendas.

Importante: Essa vaga possui uma remuneração fixa por ciclo de vendas, além do comissionamento.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Prospectar novos clientes, apresentar a Lemon e fechar vendas no formato porta a porta;
  • Realizar abordagens de leads por meio de: WhatsApp, videochamada, ligação, e-mail ou presencialmente;
  • Realizar abordagens direcionadas por listas de leads específicos selecionados pela Lemon;
  • Analisar se o cliente se enquadra nos nossos critérios de elegibilidade;
  • Garantir o correto preenchimento de todos os campos necessários na nossa ferramenta para fechar a venda;
  • Gerir o próprio funil de leads;
  • Enviar reports diários para a Lemon.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Mora em Campinas;
  • Tem técnico ou superior completo;
  • Tem pelo menos um ano de experiência como vendedor externo;
  • Se empolga com uma rotina de vendas presenciais;
  • Tem interesse pelo mercado de energia e de sustentabilidade;
  • Fica confortável em um ambiente de muitas mudanças;
  • Tem comunicação fluida e assertiva, tanto escrita como oral.

Experiência prévia/ habilidades exigidas

  • Morar em Campinas;
  • Ter pelo menos 3 anos de experiência com vendas externas;
  • Ser proativo e criativo para identificar oportunidades de melhorar a entrega de seus próprios resultados.

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Experiência prévia no setor de energia.

O que a gente oferece

  • Comissionamento atrativo;
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Materiais de trabalho;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (além dos feriados nacionais, você tem alguns dias no ano à sua escolha para curtir uma folguinha ou emendar o descanso antes ou depois de um feriado).

Diversidade & inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e, caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se você se declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade. Encorajamos que pessoas com histórias e vivências diferentes se candidatem, pois isso nos ajuda a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Overview

Join to apply for the Estágio Laboratório Tarde role at Animaltec .

A Animatec é o laboratório veterinário referência em Campinas e região. Queremos os melhores profissionais conosco, que são apaixonados pelo o que fazem e que querem crescer com a gente. Já somos em 5 unidades e vem mais por aí! Então, se você é estudante de medicina veterinária , biomedicina , biologia ou áreas relacionadas e gosta de aprender sempre, não perca a oportunidade de se inscrever no laboratório que mais cresce no Brasil! Buscamos estudantes que são engajados, comprometidos e que buscam se aperfeiçoar sempre!

Responsibilities

  • Auxiliar na coleta e preparação dos materiais;
  • Preparo de amostras biológicas, incluindo sangue, urina, fezes, tecidos, entre outros para análise laboratorial.
  • Auxiliar em testes laboratoriais básicos como hemogramas, urinálises, parasitológicos, exames de citologia/ histologia e teste sorológicos, seguindo todos os protocolos e processos estabelecidos.
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos do laboratório e estrutura da empresa mantendo-os limpo, organizado e em condições adequadas de funcionamento.
  • Registrar e organizar os resultados dos testes de forma precisa e completa.
  • Participar de reuniões e treinamentos para expandir o conhecimento sobre os procedimentos e técnicas de diagnóstico.
  • Cumprir os padrões de segurança e biossegurança do laboratório.
  • Contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo, compartilhando ideias e feedbacks com a equipe.
  • Cumprir com a ética e confidencialidade das informações internas.
  • Tratar todos os clientes e colegas de trabalho sempre de forma cortês, gentil e educada, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho tranquilo e saudável.

Qualifications

  • Estar regularmente matriculado em um curso superior na área veterinária, biologia, biomedicina ou áreas afins.
  • Ter a disponibilidade para estagiar 30 horas semanais, incluindo os sábados e feriados.
  • Possuir interesse genuíno na área de diagnóstico laboratorial veterinário.
  • Ter boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Ter a capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Conhecimento básico em técnicas de laboratório e procedimentos de segurança é uma vantagem.

Benefits

  • Oportunidade de adquirir experiência prática em um ambiente profissional.
  • Supervisão e orientação por profissionais experientes e qualificados.
  • Correlação com casos clínicos.
  • Possibilidade de aprender e desenvolver habilidades técnicas e práticas no laboratório.
  • Potencial de efetivação e crescimento na empresa.

Se você é um estudante dedicado e entusiasmado, apaixonado por cuidar da saúde e bem estar dos animais, esta é uma excelente oportunidade para você. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa equipe comprometida e dedicada em fornecer o melhor diagnóstico veterinário! Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura!
